name: security-audit-skill
description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
one_liner: A recipe that turns an AI coding assistant into a careful security reviewer that checks a codebase in stages and double-checks its own findings before reporting them.
buyer: A freelance security consultant or boutique firm who wants to offer cheap, frequent vulnerability scans to small SaaS companies that can't afford a full manual pentest.
business_use_cases: A freelance security consultant sells a monthly 'AI security nightscan' subscription to small SaaS startups, using this skill as the engine.
An MSP adds an 'AI-verified vulnerability report' upsell for the small-business websites it already hosts and manages.
A compliance-prep shop uses it to quickly generate the evidence small vendors need to answer enterprise customers' security questionnaires.

money_ideas.idea: Recurring automated audit subscription for small SaaS companies

steal_this: Offer three small SaaS founders a flat-fee 'AI security audit report in 48 hours' this weekend, delivered as a clean PDF using this skill.
